notes.title: Alpha Terminus Demo update
notes.content:
[h1][b]We are excited to share the following notes for the new update![/b][/h1]

[h2]News[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cockpit visual update
[*] Added animated arms in the cockpit (base POC)
[*] Added animated cockpit (tilting)
[*] Added skippable cutscenes with voice and subtitle
[*] New menu scene
[*] New in-game menu
[*] Added in-game subtitle
[*] Updated control
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173253/f0a181e044c48d19fe7cd7475b2133fb80d29fbc.png[/img]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed jittering in cockpit movement
[*] Added deadzone for stick-based inputs
[*] Bound the mouse cursor for the game window
[/list]

[h2]Known issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Widescreen not fully supported
[/list]
